capabilities: Convert clipboard images to WebP on paste
Name saved images with fixed or timestamp filenames
Choose save folder for pasted images
Insert embed link at the cursor automatically
extras: Not yet manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a SECURITY.md documents the size limits, and the README is duplicated in Japanese.
problem: Obsidian pastes clipboard images as-is (typically PNG), so screenshots are stored large and uncompressed without automatic conversion or naming control.
summary: Clipboard image handler that converts pasted images to WebP files with configurable names, quality, and save folder, then embeds them.
